judge_notes.opus5: Every optics peer beat (item 0) into a 55% washout, but the same-week measurement that Coherent's beat-and-raise opened +5% and closed -14% (item 6) is a near-dispositive reaction-function brake, so the sign is barely off neutral on a very large move.
judge_notes.opus55: Washed-out positioning (-55% in 20d, ~15% short) and peer beats against the DSP-shortage Q4 risk and a sector tape that sells beats; mild long lean.
judge_notes.sonnet55: Washed-out tape (-55% in 20d, ~15% short) against peer beats that were sold; only proxies and positioning, so a mild upside lean.
judge_notes.fable51: Peers all beat and a bank term loan for equipment (quiet 8-K) says the capacity ramp continues into a washed-out, 15%-short tape; the DSP-shortage risk to a Q4 guide that needs +50% sequential and a sector that is selling beats keep the lean small on an 18% straddle.

baseline.expected_move_basis: option straddle net of ordinary vol, front expiry

tape_rule: open tape_path only after release_read is written

actions.exit_open: sell (cover a short) at the opening print, market
actions.exit_1000: sell (cover a short) at market at 10:00 ET

actions.exit_close: hold through the session, out at the close
